summary: Explain what was verified, findings resolved, and remaining limits.

areas.correctness: Acceptance criteria, negative paths, realistic data and actual results.
areas.security: Inputs, authorization, secrets and dependency impact.
areas.performance: Measured impact or a justified N/A.
areas.accessibility: Keyboard, focus, semantics, contrast and reduced motion.
areas.localization: Arabic/RTL, bidi, Urdu/English and text expansion.
areas.data_integrity: Quotes, citations, library, reading state, migration/update safety.
areas.compatibility: API/installed clients, macOS/Windows and offline behavior.
